_meta.what:
One scorecard for the simulation: every test against real data the model was not tuned to,
with its pass mark. The pandemic years (2020-2022) are left out: they were not predictable.

tests.note: 77 sections; edge counts used as inputs are not scored
Region's 2025 counts, 69 sections in the city

tests.test: Regional roads, median share of counted traffic
tests.note: school trips and trips between stops are not simulated yet

tests.test: Model walkers higher on the City's sidewalk sweeper routes (ranking)
tests.note: 81 of the model's 100 busiest walking spots are on a route (11% of road nodes are)

tests.test: Highway 420 at Stanley Ave, visitor share from the 2003 (SARS) dip
tests.note: Niagara Parks Falls lot x0.813 that year; one year of partly estimated MTO counts

tests.test: Trip times, correlation with TomTom typical times (40 trips, Tuesday noon)
tests.note: routes match: model distance x1.0 of TomTom's

tests.test: Trip times, model against TomTom (median ratio, Tuesday noon)
tests.note: model about 1.5x fast; fixing it in routing hurts the count fit

tests.test: Chain branches, model median against published sales per location
